'''Ribbon in the Air''' is a [[sword form]]. Nothing but the name is known about this form. It was used in the duel between [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Turak Aladon]]. The opposing side countered with [[Stones Falling from the Cliff]].{{ref/book|2|45}} [[Galadedrid Damodred]] once used this form against a [[Trolloc]].{{ref/book|13|41}}
